text:
🇸🇪 Inspired by a recent weekend trip to Sweden here's a video set in the Swedish woods.

Using GPT-2 for character sheets, Seedance 2 for videos. 

Seedance 2 prompt example:

a swedish boy walks home to his house. In the way he uses the new magic wand to transform different objects into different objects from the 80s.

35 mm. keep color grading. no music. cinematic. masterful lighting. hand-held. depth of field.

Music was done on Magnific using Elevenlabs music generator.

In post production some RGB-shift + noise to add that retro look.

Link to Spaces workflow below.
